title: Choose a path
description: Make the story respond to a choice.

tasks.title: Give your story two possible paths
tasks.body: An if statement runs an indented block only when its condition is true. == compares two values. An else block runs when that condition is false.
tasks.detail: Use a colon after the if condition and after else. Indent the instructions inside each block by four spaces. Our example compares exact lowercase text: left. Any other reply takes the else path.

tasks.note: With left as the reply, only the waterfall line runs. With right, only the library line runs.

tasks.question: Which block runs when path is "right"?
tasks.why: "right" == "left" is false, so Python skips the if block and runs the else block.

tasks.prompt: Give both paths new discoveries. Run with left, then with right. Confirm that the discoveries differ.
Ask the player to choose left or right. Use if and else to print a different nonempty discovery for each choice. Keep the replies as lowercase left and right; invent your own discoveries.
tasks.starter:
path = input("Left or right? ")
if path == "left":
    # Print one discovery
    pass
else:
    # Print a different discovery
    pass
hints: You need two branches: one when the reply is left, and one for anything else.
Look at the two pass lines in the starter. Each one is the place for a print() with a discovery.
A pattern from another story: if answer == "yes": then an indented print(...), then else: and another indented print(...).

error_hints.text: Lines inside if and else start with four spaces. Press Tab at the start of the line to add them.
The if and else lines end with a colon, and comparing uses two equals signs: ==.
Your two branches print the same thing. Change the words in one of them.

similar_example.note: One reply, two branches, a different message in each. Your challenge compares the reply with "left".

other_ways.note: != means "is not equal to", so the branches can be written the other way round.

messages.message: Add an if condition and an else block, with an indented story message in each.
Print a discovery for each path.
Left and right currently tell the same story. Give the if and else blocks different discoveries, and compare the input variable with "left" or "right".
Your program asks once and prints a different discovery for left and for right. Which path would you pick, and does each discovery fit your story?
